name: agent_create
description: Create a new agent with specified configuration, persona, and optional injection. This allows agents to create and manage other agents.

id.description: Unique identifier for the new agent (will be auto-formatted)

description.description: Description of what this agent does and when to use it

mode.description: Agent mode: primary, worker, system, or legacy compatibility modes subagent/all.

model.description: Preferred model configuration for this agent

fallbackModel.description: Fallback model if preferred model is unavailable

steps.description: Maximum number of steps the agent can take

color.description: Hex color code for UI display

hidden.description: Whether to hide this agent from UI listings

tools.description: Specific tools this agent can use (empty array = no tools, undefined = all available tools)

skills.description: Skills allocated to this agent (skill names)

enableInjection.description: Enable dynamic prompt injection for this agent

persona.description: The agent's persona and system prompt (PERSONA.md content)
